    /// <summary>CE-446: bake the whole block, then parse Params at their offset.</summary>
    public static unsafe void BehaviorParseParams(string json, byte* memory, int capacity,
        global::Fdp.Core.EntityRepository world, global::Fdp.Core.Entity self)
    {
        if (capacity < StateSize)
            throw new global::System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity),
                $"the behaviour block holds {capacity} bytes but this blueprint needs {StateSize} (CE-446).");
        InitDefault(new global::System.Span<byte>(memory, StateSize));
        ParseParams(json, memory + ParamsOffset, capacity - ParamsOffset, world, self);
        Resolve_Resolve(ref global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.AsRef<State>(memory), world, self);
    }
    
    /// <summary>CE-446: this frame's events, then the Tick — its status ends the behaviour.</summary>
    public static unsafe global::Fbt.NodeStatus BehaviorTick(ref byte block,
        global::Fdp.Core.EntityRepository world, global::Fdp.Interfaces.IEntityCommandBuffer ecb,
        global::Fdp.Core.Entity self, float time, float deltaTime, uint instanceId)
    {
        return Tick(ref global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.As<byte, State>(ref block), world, ecb, self, time, deltaTime, instanceId);
    }
